metadata.description: All Alberta River Basins stations with automated or manual SWE / snow depth: AEPA pillows, other operators' depth sensors, snow courses (periodic), and BC Snow Survey / SNOTEL mirrors (inventory only, linked by mirror_of; archived through their own clients). No licence is stated; data are provisional per the download disclaimer.
